script:
tell application "System Events" to tell process "Bear"
	set frontmost to true
	click menu item "Copy Link" of menu "Note" of menu bar 1
end tell
delay 0.2
set theLink to (the clipboard as text)
set AppleScript's text item delimiters to "id="
set idPart to last text item of theLink
set AppleScript's text item delimiters to "&"
set noteId to first text item of idPart
set AppleScript's text item delimiters to ""
set dbPath to (POSIX path of (path to home folder)) & "Library/Group Containers/9K33E3U3T4.net.shinyfrog.bear/Application Data/database.sqlite"
set theTitle to ""
try
	set theTitle to do shell script "sqlite3 -readonly " & quoted form of dbPath & " " & quoted form of ("SELECT ZTITLE FROM ZSFNOTE WHERE ZUNIQUEIDENTIFIER='" & noteId & "' LIMIT 1;")
end try
return theTitle & tab & theLink
name: {title}
